headline: Executive order sets up an "America First" strategy for how the U.S. sells or transfers weapons to other countries.
what_it_does: This executive order creates a strategy for U.S. arms transfers, meaning sales or transfers of weapons and military equipment to other countries. Only the title is available, so the specific rules, priorities, and deadlines in the order are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: Companies that make and export weapons may see changes in how foreign arms sales are decided or processed.

who_it_affects.group: Foreign governments that buy U.S. weapons
who_it_affects.how: Countries seeking U.S. military equipment may face new priorities or procedures for getting it.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle arms sales
who_it_affects.how: Agencies such as the State and Defense Departments would likely be directed to carry out the new strategy.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 6, 2026; specific effective dates are not stated in the available information.
